title: Blue Note
description: A record sleeve in the manner of Reid Miles: two inks on warm board, a photograph from Let It Be screened into two halftone plates and the title set huge in heavy Geist, cropped hard against the edges. Drag inside the square and the sleeve is re-set the way type is pushed along a galley: the whole handoff is one push in the direction of your finger, the old words carried off the far edge front first and the new ones carried in behind them, every word at one speed, planned so each frame still holds a whole word of the title and never more than one word caught by an edge.
intent: Reference: Reid Miles' Blue Note covers (Unit Structures, Out to Lunch, The Freedom Rider, Hub-Tones), https://readymag.com/designstories/reid-miles/never-settle-into-typeface. Scale, crop and two-ink overprint do the swinging; every resting state is a finished sleeve.
